title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY SEHAT – Jammu & Kashmir Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Universalized government health assurance pathway for eligible Jammu and Kashmir residents, providing cashless hospitalization through the PM-JAY network.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility follows the current J&K SEHAT/PM-JAY enrolment and identity requirements applicable to residents.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY SEHAT – Jammu & Kashmir.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
